plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF

source_policy.map: Map and GameObjectDisplayInfo startup sources and the required liquid material/type sources are mandatory. An unavailable mandatory source is fatal.
source_policy.dependencies: A present WDT whose required ADT is malformed or otherwise fails acquisition, conversion, integrity, resource, or publication checks is fatal; only an explicitly missing WDT is recorded as unknown.
source_policy.failure: A missing WDT has unknown coverage and emits no tree or placement proof. A selected map:<id> whose WDT is missing is rejected without falling back to another map or the all-available-maps selection.

verification.source_authentication: Offline verification checks producer-reported source coverage, not an independent client snapshot.

facts: Map and GameObjectDisplayInfo source availability, declared and available bytes, full-checksum and encoded-key authentication flags, row counts, and section admission states
Liquid material/type source identities, byte counts, first-magic tags, and direct/copy/materialized row counts
Ordered startup rows with display IDs, file IDs, and collision disposition or omission reason
Map topology and per-map WDT/global status; each present WDT map records all 4096 cells with distinct own and parent-replay states
Complete ID-ordered placement proofs for present-WDT maps and size/SHA-256 bindings for every authenticated published VMap artifact

resume: A sealed resume rebuilds the genuine six-owner result and compares every artifact against the immutable published component. A complete output refuses writes.

limits.meaning: These are downward-only API budgets. The combined logical ceiling and coverage reservation are enforced before production; capacity headroom is reserved separately. Cap failures never truncate output.

legacy_preservation: v13 keeps its terminal MissingFile terrain behavior; no older-build acceptance transfers to 70425.
